Definition: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
BiblicalUsage: Kuwn is one of the great establishing words of the Old Testament, used more than two hundred times for making firm, setting up, and preparing. David's throne was established in 1 Kings 2:12, Samuel told Israel to prepare their hearts unto the Lord in 1 Samuel 7:3, David perceived that the Lord had established him king in 2 Samuel 5:12, and the Kohathites were set over the shewbread "to prepare it every sabbath" in 1 Chronicles 9:32.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the word's whole range is one promise: what God establishes stands, whether it is a throne, a heart turned to Him, or the bread set before Him every Sabbath. What God establishes stands, and I am standing on it.
